secondary_area_uncovered.reason: The same shared ExportResourceDialog is mounted by SloList.vue (slos-slolist-export-dialog / openobserve_slo), but SLO tests live in the SLO/ folder with @slo tags. Per the one-spec-one-area rule, SLO terraform export is NOT folded into this Alerts spec. A follow-up SLO/slo-terraform-export.spec.js (registered in the SLO shard) is still needed.

rationale: No existing spec covers the Terraform export dialog. alerts-import.spec.js only exercises the legacy JSON round-trip download via pm.alertsPage.exportAlerts() (JSON tab + Download). The new ExportResourceDialog (JSON/Terraform tabs, copy, empty/skipped/dropped banners, single vs bulk, tab reset) is its own feature area and run-context explicitly designates Alerts/alerts-terraform-export.spec.js. The SLO caller is a separate area and is noted as uncovered rather than frankensteined into an Alerts spec.
